name: Morphological Box
description: Combine solution concepts from parameters and options, check incompatibilities
whenToUse: When a solution consists of several sub-functions and alternative whole concepts should be combined systematically — not for scoring or choosing the concepts, that belongs to solution selection.
emptyState: No parameters yet. Use "+" to create the first sub-function of the solution.
conceptsEmpty: No concepts yet. "+" creates one; then pick one option per parameter in the box.
matrixHint: Tick the pairs of options that do not work together. Options of the same parameter exclude each other anyway.

invariants.uniqueIds: Every option, parameter and concept needs its own non-empty id.
invariants.validConflicts: An incompatible pair links two existing options of different parameters, each pair only once.
invariants.validPicks: A concept picks, per parameter, only an option of that parameter.
invariants.activeConcept: The active concept must be an existing concept.
